home.summary.041: What is outside the transfer scope?
home.p.042: Polls, events, status updates, channels, group membership change notices, chat themes and wallpapers are not supported. Complete transfer of Business labels and business profiles is not promised. Support varies by direction, system and WhatsApp version.
home.privacy-title.043: Your chats take the direct route.
home.p.044:
Data moves between your phones, without a cloud transfer server.
Use USB for iPhone transfers, or a local network between Android phones.
home.p.047:
Switching phones is enough to think about.
Here is what you need to know.
home.summary.048: Do I need a computer or an iPhone app?
home.p.049: No computer is needed. Install TransGuru on Android. Transfers involving iPhone use a USB cable that supports data. For Android to Android, install TransGuru on both phones.
home.summary.050: Will my phone work?
home.p.051: The current app requires Android 7.0 or later and USB OTG support. For iPhone transfers, you also need a data cable that fits both phones. Compatibility depends on system and WhatsApp versions. Follow the app connection checks.
home.summary.052: Can I merge old and new chats?
home.p.053: Prepare for a backup restore. In particular, Android to iPhone replaces WhatsApp data on the destination iPhone and does not merge it with existing chats. Before you begin, save separate backups of anything you need to keep on both phones.
home.summary.054: How long does a transfer take?
home.p.055: The time depends on chat and media size, phone performance and connection speed. Allow enough time, charge and free storage. Keep the phones connected until the app tells you the transfer is complete.
home.summary.056: Are my chats uploaded to a server?
home.p.057: TransGuru does not use a cloud server to transfer chats. Cross-platform transfers use USB; Android to Android uses a local hotspot or the same Wi-Fi. Diagnostic logs are shared only when you choose a recipient through the system share sheet. The image recognition component may send technical diagnostics; see the Privacy Policy. Installing or updating WhatsApp may need internet access.
home.summary.058: Does it support WhatsApp Business?
home.p.059: The app lets you choose WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business. Compatibility is still being improved across transfer directions. Complete transfer of Business labels, business profiles and sign-in state is not promised. Keep the original backup and check important chats after the restore.
home.summary.060: Where can I download TransGuru?
home.p.061: Public downloads are being prepared. A verified download link will appear here after release. You can prepare now or check the GitHub releases page.
